# Portfolio development instructions

This repository contains a professional UX/Product Designer portfolio.

## Technology
Use only:
- HTML5
- CSS3
- vanilla JavaScript

Do not introduce:
- React
- Vue
- Angular
- TypeScript
- jQuery
- Bootstrap
- Tailwind
- npm dependencies
- build systems

The final website must run directly on GitHub Pages.

## Architecture
Keep reusable styles in assets/css/styles.css.
Keep reusable JavaScript in assets/js/main.js.
Use semantic HTML.
Prefer reusable CSS components and design tokens.
Avoid duplicated CSS and JavaScript.

## UX
The design should communicate:
- AI-driven product design
- UX orchestration
- systems thinking
- forward-thinking product strategy
- sophisticated interaction design

Prioritize:
- usability
- information hierarchy
- responsive design
- accessibility
- restrained animation
- high-quality micro-interactions

## Responsive design
Design mobile-first.
Support phones, tablets, laptops and large desktop monitors.
Avoid fixed widths that cause horizontal scrolling.

## Accessibility
Use appropriate landmarks and heading hierarchy.
Include alt text where appropriate.
Support keyboard navigation.
Provide visible focus states.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Maintain sufficient text contrast.

## GitHub Pages
Use relative internal links.
Do not require a server-side runtime.
Do not add code that requires Node.js to run in production.

## Code quality
Use clear naming.
Keep JavaScript unobtrusive and modular.
Avoid unnecessary abstractions.
Comment only where the implementation is not self-explanatory.
